name: Flower Beam
description: Gathers sunlight and fires a solar beam from which sharp leaves sprout on both sides; where it ends, an explosion of petals blooms.

name: Fiery Whirlwind
description: Launches a fire whirl that pulls in enemies and feeds it with a Flamethrower: it grows, spits spiraling flames and explodes.

name: Hydro Spiral
description: You spin inside your shell and push nearby enemies away while two Hydro Pump jets sweep everything around you like a sprinkler.

name: Ball Storm
description: Launches a big electric ball that floats over the horde and acts as a lightning rod: thunder strikes it and chains outward until it falls and explodes.

name: Resonant Web
description: Throws silk webs that stick to the ground and trap; then a buzz makes them vibrate and each web releases a sound wave that punishes the trapped more.

name: Lethal Sting
description: Calls a swarm of Beedrill that dive with their stingers; where they sting they leave toxic spikes on the ground.

name: Feather Cyclone
description: A hurricane advances on the enemies dragging them along, and cutting wings fly out of it nonstop, back and forth.

name: Ravenous Chomp
description: Fangs leap from enemy to enemy biting each one; each bite also tears away 6% of its remaining health (not bosses).

name: Celestial Drill
description: A drill beak falls from the sky onto the enemy, sinks into the earth and comes out again beneath three others, one after another.

name: Corrosive Grime
description: A pile of garbage falls on the enemies and leaves an acid puddle that poisons and corrodes: those who step in it take more damage.

name: Seismic Ball
description: A rock ball rolls in circles around you; each bounce shakes the ground and at the end it lands with a great earthquake.

name: Toxic Tide
description: A wave of poison leaves you in a circle; enemies that were already poisoned burst into splashes that infect those beside them.

name: Tectonic Horn
description: A ghostly horn charges in a straight line and splits the ground: along the fissure, earth geysers burst one after another.

name: Gravitational Moon
description: A small moon appears over the enemies and pulls them in with its gravity; then it falls and bursts into star shards.

name: Nine-Tail Dance
description: Nine will-o'-wisps spin around you like tails and launch one by one at the enemies; each bursts into a ring of psychic fire that burns and confuses.

name: Grand Concert
description: A lullaby puts the surrounding enemies to sleep and, once they are asleep, a huge booming voice hits them hard and wakes them.

name: Vampire Wing
description: A supersonic echo marks the surrounding enemies and air blades seek the marked and return part of the life they steal.

name: Dancing Garden
description: The petals spinning around you open into a spiral storm and close again; they hit on the way out and back and leave clouds of poison dust.

name: Fungal Bomb
description: Throws energy balls that make a mushroom sprout where they land; the mushroom releases sleep spores and soon bursts.

name: Scale Prism
description: Releases a cloud of silver scales ahead and fires a signal beam at it: the scales refract it into a fan of colored beams.

name: Dugtrio's Fissure
description: A fissure runs along the ground toward the enemies; along it Diglett and Dugtrio pop up and spit mud at those nearby.

name: Golden Rain
description: Coins rain on the surrounding enemies, then you leap into a playful scuffle in a dust cloud where they pile up most.

name: Torrential Migraine
description: A jet soaks the enemies ahead and Psyduck's headache bursts into psychic orbs on the wet ones, splashing those beside them.

name: Unleashed Tantrum
description: Throws fists of rage that chase the enemies, and every hit makes the ground tremble. The less health you have left, the harder it hits.

name: Fiery Stampede
description: A fire silhouette leaves you at full speed and zigzags between several enemies leaving a burning trail; at the end it explodes.

name: Hypnotic Spiral
description: A great hypnotic spiral turns on the ground and pulses, lulling enemies to sleep, while bubble beams spiral out of it.

name: Prismatic Premonition
description: Marks several enemies with runes; shortly after, rifts open in the air around them and Psybeams converge on them.

name: Four-Arm Combo
description: Four lightning-fast strikes in a cross against four enemies and, to finish, a Dynamic Punch whose shockwave confuses everything nearby.

name: Carnivorous Whip
description: Throws vines that catch up to three enemies and drag them toward you; then acid jaws bite everything around you.

name: Jellyfish Whirl
description: A whirlpool pulls in the enemies; tentacles sprout around it and poison jumps in a chain among all the trapped.

name: Magnitude 10
description: An earthquake of random magnitude between 4 and 10: the higher it is, the harder it shakes and the more rocks fall from the sky.

name: Gloomy Curse
description: A Shadow Ball bursts and curses; then misfortune jumps from enemy to enemy with will-o'-wisps and deals double damage to those suffering any status.

name: Dance of Bones
description: A bone and a dark bone trace figure eights around you, hitting everything they cross; the dark one leaves a trail of ghostly fire.

name: Celestial Cross Slash
description: Four giant air slashes arrive from the corners and cross in an X over the enemy, where they burst into a gale of blades.

name: Gyarados's Fury
description: A waterfall bursts from the ground, Gyarados emerges from it and sweeps a huge arc with a Hyper Beam.

name: Glacial Tide
description: A wave advances and freezes as it goes into a wall of ice that soon bursts into freezing shards.

name: Star Gambit
description: Meteors' stars spin around you, gather over the enemy and fall as a giant star of your current form's type.

name: Crushing Nap
description: A huge shadow grows over the enemies and Snorlax drops like a stone: the ground trembles in waves and, after the blow, it takes a little nap that heals you a bit.

name: Draconic Rain
description: You fire a Dragon Pulse into the sky that splits into a rain of draconic comets on the enemies; each one leaves violet fire.

name: Primeval Bubble
description: A pink bubble grows over the enemies and traps them inside; when it pops, it strikes them with psychic force and moonlight.

name: Sacred Gallop
description: A fire Rapidash gallops between the enemies leaving burning hoofprints, and columns of sacred fire fall in its wake.

name: Psychic Geyser
description: A psychic ring expands from you and, as it passes, geysers of boiling water burst that burn and confuse.

name: Magnetic Field
description: Magnets stick to several enemies and pull them against each other; then a Flash Cannon pierces the pile.

name: Starry Leek
description: The leek falls from the sky like a meteor wrapped in feathers and stars, and its impact releases a shockwave and shooting stars.

name: Triple Ruckus
description: Three heads peck three different enemies at once, three times in a row, while their racket stuns everyone around.

name: Aurora Borealis
description: Aurora curtains descend from the sky and sweep over enemies, freezing them; then a polar chill bursts and deals double damage to the frozen.

name: Sludge Tide
description: A sludge belch floods the ground in front of you and leaves toxic puddles that spit waste balls at nearby enemies.

name: Icicle Rain
description: Fires icicles into the sky that fall in a circle on the enemies and stay stuck for a moment; at the end a giant icicle drops.

name: Rock Snake
description: A rock serpent advances underground in a zigzag: its rocks burst the ground as it passes and leave sharp stone traps.

name: Dreamy Feast
description: A pendulum puts surrounding enemies to sleep and steals their dreams: energy beams run from the sleepers to you, damaging them and healing you.

name: Tsunami Claw
description: A giant claw falls from the sky and strikes the ground; the impact sends out a wave that wipes out everything ahead of you.

name: Chain Reaction
description: Drops Voltorbs around you that sizzle and explode one after another: each explosion sets off the next.

name: Explosive Harvest
description: Throws eggs that burst into seeds; a palm tree sprouts from each one and crashes down on the surrounding enemies.

name: Hurricane Kick
description: A flurry of spinning kicks raises a whirlwind that advances on the enemies; at the end, a kick falls from the sky like a meteor.

name: Glacial Fist
description: Focuses power into an icy fist that freezes the enemies ahead; a second precise blow shatters them.

name: Giant Lick
description: A huge tongue sweeps an arc in front of you, catches the enemies and slams them into the ground with all its weight.

name: Detonating Cloud
description: Clouds of toxic smoke spread among the enemies and poison them; then they ignite and explode one after another.

name: Megalithic Charge
description: A ghost rhino charges in a straight line trampling everything; at the end of its run a huge boulder falls.

name: Sonic Egg
description: Throws lucky eggs that crack open with a bang: each one releases sound waves and a bit of energy that heals you.

name: Solar Tangle
description: Vines catch nearby enemies and drain their life; then a blade of sunlight cuts all the entangled.

name: Parental Double
description: Mother and child attack together: a Mega Punch and a Mega Kick on the same enemy, twice in a row, and every blow shakes those around.

name: Abyssal Ink
description: Fires ink balls that blind enemies; shortly after, a Hydro Cannon falls from the sky onto each ink stain.

name: Torpedo Horn
description: A water torpedo with a steel horn chases the enemies, pierces them one after another and ends with a bite that raises a wave.

name: Photon Star
description: A water star spins toward the enemies and, as it spins, fires beams of light in all directions; when it stops, it bursts into a geyser of photons.

name: Explosive Wall
description: Raises four crystal panels that enclose a group of enemies and sets off a fairy mist inside the box.

name: Glacial Kiss
description: Throws kisses that put enemies ahead to sleep and charm them, then blows an icy breath that freezes the kissed.

name: Flashing Cage
description: Traps a group in a cage of lightning that paralyzes them and unleashes a Discharge from the sky inside it.

name: Volcanic Eruption
description: A volcano rises from the ground in front of you, belches burning smoke and spits lava bombs that rain around it.

name: Titanic Guillotine
description: Grabs the nearest enemy with its horns, flips it and hurls it into the horde: where it lands, a brutal shockwave bursts.

name: Stampede
description: Calls a herd of Tauros that charges the enemies one after another: each goring blow lifts the ground and sends them flying.

name: Metamorfusion
description: Ditto transforms with every cast: it copies the signature fusion of a random League member.

name: Binary Overload
description: Three data cubes orbit around you linked by Fusion Bolt arcs and fire Techno Blasts at nearby enemies.

name: Ancient Deluge
description: The shell gathers water and fires a meteor beam into the sky; the sky answers with torrents of water and rocks on the enemies.

name: Fossil Slash
description: Two scythes slash in a cross in front of you, and sharp spinning shells fly out of the cut, piercing the enemies.

name: Prehistoric Dive
description: A winged shadow dives from the sky with electric fangs and crashes in a paralyzing blast.

name: Ice Age
description: An icy gale of ice feathers sweeps what is ahead and behind it a wave of ice covers the ground and freezes the enemies.

name: Supreme Storm
description: Charges and fires an electro beam that pierces everything; wherever it passes a storm breaks out and lightning strikes along its path.

name: Phoenix Sun
description: A fire phoenix dives onto the enemies and bursts into a small sun that scorches everything.

name: Genetic Supremacy
description: Psychic fragments spin around you and lodge in the enemies; then a Psyshock falls and mind-wave beams cross it in a star shape.
